ValidationRule.description: Mandate Priority Reason when Priority is High
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISBLANK(Priority_Reason__c),
OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Priority, "High"), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Frequent_Flyer_Request"), /*Frequent Flyer*/ AND ( ISPICKVAL (Priority, "Yes"), $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sales_Offers_Request")) /*Sales Offers*/ )
